scope: Only compression layout changes. JSON/CSV raw bytes, paths, record order, loader interfaces, source process storage, completion and bibliography exports are unchanged.
fallback: At >=50MiB use a lossless single-member gzip. If that remains >=50MiB reject the build with an explicit bounded-shard planning message; never truncate records.
required_adoption_order: Verify the exact two code targets and proofs.
Apply code only with the dedicated helper.
Root builds unified normally, retaining all historical input/archive gzip bytes.
Check decoded export SHA preservation against the selected build inputs.
limitations: Old compressed SHAs change on new builds; immutable historical gzip archives are not rewritten.
Concatenated gzip members do not themselves provide HTTP range/delta transfer or prove actual Git pack gains.
Layout reuse example fixes metadata and record order; a real metadata/order change can affect other members.
